subject: Assurance onboarding: ISO Annex A / SOC 2 evidence & crosswalk request
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@aureum.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@aureum.com
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: RFP assurance pack + annex A / SOC 2 asks

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking the RFP. Our security and procurement teams are working through the assurance section and we need a few clarifications to map your answers into our evaluation matrix. Attached is our questionnaire (Aureum_RFP_Security_Questions_v2.xlsx). Specific asks: 
- A crosswalk from SOC 2 controls (or your SOC 2 report sections) to ISO 27001 Annex A controls where applicable.
- Confirmation of the SOC 2 Type II coverage period and whether the report is shareable under an NDA.
- Sample artifacts that demonstrate encryption at rest (both hosted & private deployment), KMS key rotation evidence, and a system/service architecture diagram showing customer data flows.
- A short list of subprocessors and whether any subprocessors have access to unredacted customer data.

Can you confirm what you can provide within the next 5 business days? If some artifacts require an NDA, please point us to the DocuSign link or contact for legal.

Best,
Marta Alvarez
Security Program Manager
Aureum Systems

Attachment: Aureum_RFP_Security_Questions_v2.xlsx

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@aureum.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: RFP assurance pack + annex A / SOC 2 asks

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list and the spreadsheet. I’ve looped in Neha (Security Lead) and Karthik (Security Engineer) to own the artifact side. High-level plan:

- We will draft an ISO Annex A <-> SOC 2 crosswalk and populate it with references to the sections in our SOC 2 summary.
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary immediately; the full report requires an NDA (we can provide a DocuSign link).
- Example artifacts (architecture diagram, key-rotation snippets, S3 policy excerpts, SIEM retention screenshot) — we’ll upload a curated packet by EOD 2026-10-05.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call on Tuesday 2026-10-06 to confirm the priority artifacts and any additional format needs (CSV mapping vs our preferred CSV + PDF)? I’ll create a shared folder and upload the initial set.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Drive folder (incoming): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-Aureum-evidence

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@aureum.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: ISO Annex A crosswalk & artifact inventory (first pass)

Hi Marta — Neha here. Below is a concise inventory and what we can deliver in the next 72 hours. I’m starting with the controls you highlighted and the quickest-to-provide artifacts. I’ll add the rest to the Drive as we confirm scope.

1) SOC 2 coverage and shareability
- SOC 2 Type II (coverage period: 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31).
- We can provide a redacted executive summary (RI_SOC2_TypeII_202506-202605_summary.pdf) now. Full report: available under NDA.

2) ISO 27001 Annex A crosswalk
- We will deliver a CSV mapping (iso-annexa-crosswalk.csv) that maps Annex A controls to corresponding SOC 2 common criteria and our internal policy artifacts. Example mapping rows: A.8.1 -> Access control policy section 3.2 -> SOC2 CC6; A.12.4 -> Logging & monitoring -> SOC2 CC7.

3) Encryption & key management
- Hosted API (multi-tenant): encryption at rest via customer-tenant-isolated envelopes; AES-256 at rest; KMS provider: AWS KMS + HSM-backed key material for Dedicated/Private options.
- Artifacts we will upload: key-rotation audit sample (rotation_log_excerpt_202609.csv), kms-configuration-snippet.txt, and a short note explaining HSM attestation posture for private deployments.

4) Dataflow & architecture
- We will include a redacted system architecture diagram (redwood-system-arch-customer-view.pdf) showing data-at-rest boundaries for Hosted / Dedicated / Private.

5) Logging & retention
- SIEM retention: 1 year searchable logs, 3 years cold storage (config screenshot). We’ll add a sample alert/playbook extract and a screenshot from the log retention dashboard.

6) Third parties / subprocessors
- Subprocessor list (redacted) will be provided. We will flag any subprocessors that may touch unredacted customer data (none for hosted API; some for managed Dedicated services — will note).

7) Time & format
- Priority: SOC 2 executive summary + Annex A crosswalk + architecture diagram + KMS rotation sample by 2026-10-05 EOD.
- Remaining items (penetration test summary, SIEM screenshots, retention policy excerpts) by 2026-10-08.

If you have a specific control ID set you want prioritized in the crosswalk, send those control IDs and we’ll promote them to the top of the upload queue.

Thanks — Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments to follow: RI_SOC2_TypeII_202506-202605_summary.pdf, iso-annexa-crosswalk.csv

From: Tom Rodgers <tom.rodgers@aureum.com>

Hi Neha / Jordan — this looks good and very helpful. A couple quick clarifications before the call: 

- Encryption at rest: please confirm whether customer-managed keys (BYOK/HSM) are supported for Private deployments and whether Redwood can provide an HSM attestation (vendor statement / cert).
- For Dedicated deployments we need an example of the network ACLs and a sample VPC peering diagram (we can accept redacted).
- For procurement: will you accept a partial artifact set (redacted reports + technical excerpts) as interim evidence while an NDA is in flight? Our legal team will send a signed NDA if you provide a DocuSign link — otherwise we’ll route a scanned signature.

Timing is tight for us — it would be ideal to receive the priority artifacts by EOD Monday 2026-10-05.

Thanks,
Tom Rodgers
Sr. Procurement Manager
Aureum Systems
